_note: SAMPLE schema only — NOT read by the site. The LIVE file will be data/instagram.json, generated by GitHub Actions from Instagram @m.s.gk after Meta auth is set up. The (future) front-end JS fetches data/instagram.json, sorts posts by timestamp DESC, takes the latest 4 POSTS (one thumbnail per post), and renders them into every [data-ig-gallery] (TOP #ms-instagram-gallery-top and works.html #ms-instagram-gallery). If this file is missing/empty/has <4 items, or JS is off, the fixed fallback images images/ms-01..04 remain. Thumbnail per type: image=post image, carousel=first slide (cover), reel=thumbnail_url(cover). TOP and works share the SAME json and the SAME local images (do not manage images separately).
